summary: A new assignment reaches writers who already have deadlines for the same campaign.
realLife: Murphy recalled assigning work ahead of time, then learning that Samuel Rosenman was approaching the same Washington writers for his own campaign speech assignments.
inGame: needs: existing assignments and requested deadline.

turns.what: They agree who will receive each draft.
turns.writesBack: The writer can deliver one version to the right desk.

turns.what: The writer asks which deadline comes first.
turns.writesBack: One of the aides must resolve the conflict.
